The '''GT-13 Maintenance Response Droid''' was a [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]] model used by [[The Shroud's syndicate|the Shroud's organization]]. Droids of this type were posted inside [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]]'s secret facility on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].
